title: nixos/tlsrpt: configure explicit http_script
reason: Real new mkOption 'reportd.settings.http_script' added, giving an explicit default HTTP client invocation instead of relying on an implicit one.

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: Real new option, correctly not-found at base, discoverable at head but untested -- expected, not a gap.
